title: ReA-Bench: Benchmarking Responsible Agent Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2611.16493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As agents perform tasks autonomously in local and cloud environments, auditing their execution trajectories can help service providers identify risks and improve agent harnesses and foundation models. Our analysis of production and red-team trajectories shows that some risks are repeatedly missed across auditing configurations. Overall recall obscures which risks are missed and whether higher recall comes with more false positives on legitimate behavior. Existing benchmarks offer limited insight into these failures. Generated trajectories can contain inconsistent tool calls and responses, conspicuous risky actions, or repetitive attack patterns. Grouping results by risk type also makes it difficult to tell whether auditors overlooked evidence, accepted an unsupported conclusion, or lacked information needed to make a judgment.   We introduce ReA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for auditing responsible agent behavior. It organizes auditing

translated_title: ReA-Bench：负责任智能体审计基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着智能体在本地和云环境中自主执行任务，审计其执行轨迹可以帮助服务提供商识别风险，并改进智能体框架和基础模型。我们对生产环境和红队测试轨迹的分析表明，某些风险在各种审计配置下会被反复遗漏。总体召回率掩盖了哪些风险被遗漏，以及更高的召回率是否伴随着对合法行为的更多误报。现有基准测试对此类失败提供的洞察有限：生成的轨迹可能包含不一致的工具调用与响应、显而易见的风险行为或重复的攻击模式；而按风险类型对结果进行分组，也难以判断审计者是忽略了证据、接受了缺乏依据的结论，还是缺乏做出判断所需的信息。我们提出了ReA-Bench，一个用于审计负责任智能体行为的诊断性基准测试。它对审计……（摘要在此处截断，后续内容不完整）
tldr: 提出了ReA-Bench——首个针对负责任智能体审计的诊断性基准测试，能够深入揭示审计系统遗漏了哪些风险、以及审计失败的具体原因（如忽略证据、结论缺乏依据或信息不足）。
en_tdlr: We introduce ReA-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for auditing responsible agent behavior that goes beyond overall recall to reveal which risks are missed and why audits fail.
